title: MusicOS 2.0.4 is Here!
message:
Hey everyone!

MusicOS Version 2.0.4 is officially here!

What is new in this update:

- Redesigned Onboarding: Sleek AMOLED pure black welcome screen with the elegant Water Waves emblem.
- Fluid Scroll Animations: Smooth spring pop-up animations when scrolling through Albums, Playlists, Artists, and Track lists.
- Refined Settings: Beautiful spring entrance animations and transitions for Settings sections and Account card.
- Enhanced Menus: Fluid spring physics for the Account Switcher and 3-dot track options popovers.
- Visual Polish: Fixed playing equalizer indicator badge display on album artwork.
- Dynamic Spotlight: Multi-shelf Featured Spotlight on Home with automatic advance.
- Performance Boost: Faster load times, reduced stutter, and optimized fluid navigation throughout the app.

Thank you so much for your continuous love and support!

— Developer of MusicOS
